windows.reason: Windows file systems used by Core do not preserve distinct case-variant fixture names, and Windows does not provide the Unix symbolic-link and FIFO file types required by these source-acquisition fixtures.

macos.reason: The reviewed default macOS APFS runner file system is case-insensitive and normalizes Unicode file names, so it cannot materialize the distinct case-collision or NFC/NFD fixture paths required by UnitT09 and UnitT09d.

linux.reason: The reviewed Linux runner file system preserves distinct case variants and Unicode normalization forms and supports the Unix file types required by all source-acquisition fixtures.
